Maya (Product): Quick sync — we need a scope decision for the upcoming milestone. Customer-driven embeddings cache (embcache) is high-impact but adds infra surface. Proposal: MVP = simple per-tenant LRU prefix cache + disabled by default; v1 = full shared embcache with eviction policies. Thoughts?
Jun (Eng): +1 to conservative MVP. Implementation/ETA?
Arman (SRE): If we enable by default for MVP there's SLO risk (cold fill storms). Need autoscaling and circuit-breaker.
Priya (Sales): Acme pilot asked for embcache ON by default. They're willing to be on dedicated infra.
Leo (PM): Tradeoff: ship faster vs. opening capacity ops work. Can we do canary for dedicated tenants?
Maya (Product): Canary plan sounds good. Suggest: 1) MVP default OFF, opt-in tenants via feature flag 2) Run 1-week canary for Acme on dedicated pool 3) Measure hit rate, tail latency.
Jun (Eng): Implementation sketch:
```
feature_flag: embcache_opt_in
routing: tenant->dedicated_pool if flag
metrics: embcache.hit_rate, p99_latency
```
I can get a PR by Fri.
Arman (SRE): Add a circuit breaker: if p99 > 300ms or error rate > 1% -> disable cache for tenant. I can wire Ops alerts.
Priya (Sales): Acme happy with opt-in and canary. Need <2% tail latency regression.
Leo (PM): Decision: MVP = opt-in canary only; v1 = global ON with autoscale + regression guards. Action items: Jun PR, Arman alerting, Maya write rollbook, Priya coordinate Acme.
Maya (Product): I'll capture in ticket and run stakeholders sync 10am Wed. @Jun @Arman please ack.
Jun (Eng): Ack — PR target Fri.
Arman (SRE): Ack — I'll stand up alerts and canary dashboard.
ReleaseBot: deploy scheduled for canary pool at 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z :rocket:
